verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Osborne Clarke has a dedicated emerging companies and venture capital team, plus free founder resources such as an investor-readiness tool and cap table templates. Nothing in the pack documents a program or partnership with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that gives early startups structured access. The general startup advisory services and resources are adjacent and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents programs or partnerships with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that give early startups structured access
